note: Dense embedding integration contract for fractal-map multi-view deployment. TF-IDF citation hybrids remain PRIMARY product mode (jurist preference JP 0.78-0.79). Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY views only. This contract defines acceptance criteria for when legal-distance delivers 174k dense embeddings (blocked on corpus lane: BGE/bger ID mapping + parquet 2022-2026).

primary_product_mode.role: PRIMARY navigation mode (beats simple semantic baseline JP 0.43)

complementary_views.description: Dense embeddings recover citation heritage (doctrinal proximity through shared citations) better than TF-IDF citation-based methods
Sachverhalt (legally relevant facts) section shows strongest cross-lingual alignment in dense embeddings
complementary_views.full_corpus_density: BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k scale (corpus lane resumption required)

complementary_views.description: Dispositiv (holding/outcome) section shows moderate cross-lingual alignment
complementary_views.full_corpus_density: BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k scale (corpus lane resumption required)

complementary_views.description: Erwaegungen (reasoning) section shows weakest cross-lingual alignment — below threshold
complementary_views.note: Reasoning is most language-specific; not suitable for cross-lingual view
complementary_views.product_integration: NOT INCLUDED — does not meet acceptance criterion

complementary_views.description: Linear combination of TF-IDF citation hybrids + dense embeddings at optimal weight (w=0.3-0.4 dense)
complementary_views.acceptance_criterion: PASS both adversarial gates (language_dominance < 0.85, jurist_preference > 0.5) at optimal weight w=0.3-0.4
complementary_views.note: PASS adversarial but REMAIN BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). Optimal weight shifts toward TF-IDF dominance (w=0.3-0.4 dense / 0.6-0.7 TF-IDF). Citation signals dominate jurist preference; semantic signals add cross-lingual benefit but dilute legal relevance.

infrastructure_readiness.webgl_pipeline: VALIDATED at 174k TF-IDF (<3s), ready for dense
